title: testLocation
responsibility: Builds the canonical tests address used by regression checkpoint links.

inputs.name: testLocation.route
inputs.description: The current explorer address supplies the branch retained in the tests location. For a truthy target id, entityLens replaces its commit, category, entity and tab; a matching function helper may carry over.

inputs.name: testLocation.entity
inputs.description: Only its id and category are read and used as the target location entity and category. A falsy id makes entityLens return before adding either the entity or tests tab; this function does not validate the id.

inputs.name: testLocation.commit
inputs.description: Commit revision to use for the target entity tests. It is passed to entityLens unchanged, without validation or normalization.

outputs.name: testLocation
outputs.description: Explorer address for the target entity tests at the supplied commit, retaining the route branch and using the entity category. When the entity id is truthy, the address includes that entity and the tests tab; entityLens may also retain a matching function helper from the route.
